meta.source: milkyano.com, pixelandprofits.com, elkiyagroup.com, Milkyano Digital Master Template (Google Slides)
meta.canvas: Slides are 1920 x 1080. Sizes below are slide pixels.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Slide background. Dark adds a top-centre glow (glow-dark); light adds glow-light.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Centre colour of the radial glow at the top of a slide. Background only, never behind body text edges.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, windows, chart frames.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, chart rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, chips, window dots, context bars in dark.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Corner grid texture (from milkyano.com). Draw as SVG line art, never a repeating gradient.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, numbers, card titles.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, labels, sources, footers. 4.5:1+ on ground and panel.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Milkyano blue. Second line of a headline, the focus bar in a chart, primary button, step numbers. One focus per chart. The client colour replaces this token only.

tokens.name: focus-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary series, chip text in dark, second-ranked bars.

tokens.name: focus-wash
tokens.usage: Background of inactive step numbers and focus badges.

tokens.name: context
tokens.usage: Everything a chart is NOT about: other channels, past periods, competitors.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Real gains only: revenue or profit up, 'Scale' tags, Live badge. Always paired with a ▲ or a word.

tokens.name: gain-wash
tokens.usage: Background of gain badges.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Risks, missing data, declines, benchmarks/targets, 'Cut' tags. Always paired with a ▼, a dashed line or a word.

tokens.name: risk-wash
tokens.usage: Background of risk badges.

tokens.name: on-focus
tokens.usage: Text on a focus-filled button or badge.

tokens.name: client
tokens.usage: Set per client deck. Fill colour of the client (e.g. Coca-Cola #f40009). Defaults to focus.

tokens.name: client-ink
tokens.usage: Set per client deck. A shade of the client colour that reaches 4.5:1 on ground, for small text (Coca-Cola: #b30008 on light).

styles.name: cover
styles.sample: Show the numbers that actually matter.
styles.usage: Cover and section openers. Two lines: statement, then the turn in focus.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Google says it's working. Store traffic says otherwise.
styles.usage: Every content slide. Line 1 ink = the fact; line 2 focus = the turn. It is the takeaway, never a topic name.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and block titles, chart titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: One or two plain sentences, no jargon.
styles.usage: Body, card text, notes. Never below 24px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, axis/bar labels, sources, footers. Smallest size allowed.

tokens.name: margin-x
tokens.usage: Left and right slide margins.

tokens.name: margin-top
tokens.usage: Top margin; the chip sits here.

tokens.name: margin-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom margin when a footer is present.

tokens.name: footer-y
tokens.usage: Footer row distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Between headline block and body.

tokens.name: gap-md
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: gap-sm
tokens.usage: Inside cards, between label and value.

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and windows (Elkiya Group rounding).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, buttons, badges, split bars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Light-mode cards only. Dark cards use a line border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Dark 'window' cards placed on a light slide.
